market_view: Iran war is escalating into a dual-chokepoint oil shock (Brent headlines above $100, tankers struck off Saudi Arabia, Red Sea attacks); the 10-year yield is at its highest since January 2025 on inflation fear, and new sweeping US tariffs on 60+ partners add macro risk. VIX is moderate at 16.6 but rose 6% in 5 days; it is earnings season.

oil_gas.catalyst: 'Brent crude crosses $100 after tankers reportedly struck off Saudi Arabia' (CNBC) and 'Oil prices rise after Rubio says Iran is not serious about a deal' (CNBC): supply shock still widening, no de-escalation
oil_gas.reasoning: Keep existing XOM long (renewed 07-20, ends about 08-03). Supply threat now spans Hormuz and Red Sea and diplomacy stalled; XOM moves only 0.3-0.6x crude, so not fully priced. Reversal risk on any ceasefire; Q2 earnings add variance.

gold_miners.catalyst: none qualifying: 'Newmont tops profit estimates on higher gold prices, sees steady output' (Reuters) is a beat with unchanged guidance
gold_miners.reasoning: NEM beat but only reaffirmed guidance; stock already +3.5% on 07-22. Gold in a bear market with the 10-year yield at an 18-month high and a firm dollar; no one-sided setup.

chips.catalyst: none for NVDA; 'AMD says its newest AI server is in full production, will ship in months' (Reuters) is a competitive negative
chips.reasoning: NVDA headlines are a Korea research lab, not demand or export news. AMD Helios ramp and Anthropic deal pressure NVDA share; big tech earnings ahead add variance only.

pharma.catalyst: considered: 'Lilly's triple agonist, retatrutide, successful in two additional Phase 3 obesity trials' (Eli Lilly); judged largely expected
pharma.reasoning: Additional Phase 3 wins confirm an already-known strong programme; LLY is +31.6% over 60 days so success is mostly priced. Q2 earnings early August add variance. Close to the bar but not a surprise; stay flat.

copper_uranium.catalyst: none for FCX; 'Saudi Arabia and US strike deal for kingdom to enrich uranium' (Guardian) is long-dated and indirect
copper_uranium.reasoning: FCX +3.9% on 07-22 with copper down, no named reason. New tariffs on 60 partners are an unclear demand risk for copper. Uranium deal is years from affecting demand and the leader is FCX.

would_change_my_mind: An Iran ceasefire or Hormuz/Red Sea reopening would flip oil to flat; an LLY guidance raise or a gold rally on falling yields would bring pharma or gold miners into consideration.

handoff.what_changed: Oil shock widened: Brent headlines above $100 after tankers struck off Saudi Arabia and Red Sea attacks, Rubio says Iran not serious about a deal; WTI 86.8 (+9.1% 5d), Brent 94.1 close. The 10-year yield hit its highest since January 2025 on inflation fear and the US imposed new tariffs on 60+ partners. NEM beat Q2 with steady guidance; LLY reported two more retatrutide Phase 3 wins.

oil_gas.position: long XOM since 2026-07-07, 10 days (renewed 2026-07-20, ends about 2026-08-03)
oil_gas.why: Iran war supply shock now spans Hormuz and the Red Sea with no de-escalation; held, not re-extended.

gold_miners.why: NEM Q2 beat with unchanged guidance; gold bear market and rising yields give no one-sided setup.

chips.why: No NVDA catalyst; AMD Helios in full production is a competitive negative.

pharma.why: Retatrutide Phase 3 wins judged largely expected and priced after LLY's 60-day rally.

copper_uranium.why: No FCX catalyst; new tariffs unclear for copper; Saudi uranium deal indirect and long-dated.

handoff.next_job: On the next decision day, read this note; exit XOM to flat if the Iran conflict de-escalates (ceasefire, Hormuz or Red Sea reopening) or the horizon (about 2026-08-03) has ended, otherwise check its Q2 result and keep; then re-check all five families for a named catalyst, especially LLY Q2 guidance and NVDA/export news.
